patterns.note: Content is primarily centrally aligned, framed by decorative horizontal rules with subtle cross motifs that act as visual section dividers.
A highly decorative script font is used for prominent headings and calls to action, contrasted with a classic, elegant serif font for body text, navigation, and project titles.
A very limited, high-contrast palette of deep, dark forest green for backgrounds and a soft, off-white for all text and decorative line art elements.

Main content scrolls vertically over large, fixed, intricate line-art illustrations that serve as background elements, creating a layered depth effect where foreground text moves independently of the decorative backdrop.
Sections are visually delineated by large, ornate, line-art illustrations (e.g., gothic arches, an oval pool) that act as fixed background frames for the scrolling content.

technique_notes: The site employs a layering technique where main content scrolls vertically, revealing and obscuring large, intricate, fixed background illustrations. This creates a subtle parallax-like depth, with the foreground content moving independently of the decorative background elements. This effect is likely achieved using CSS keyframes for positioning or transform properties.

Content is primarily centered within the viewport, with visual structure provided by decorative horizontal rules that feature small cross or plus sign motifs, subtly segmenting the page without harsh lines.

Typography establishes an elegant hierarchy by pairing a distinctive, ornate script font for display headings with a refined serif font for all other textual content, ensuring readability while maintaining a sophisticated aesthetic.

design_tokens.type_scale: Ornate script headings are significantly larger (~3-4x body) and more decorative than the classic serif body text, with small uppercase serif labels for navigation and metadata.
design_tokens.spacing: airy — generous vertical spacing between sections and content blocks, creating a calm and unhurried visual rhythm.

standout: The site's distinctive use of large, intricate, fixed line-art illustrations as background elements for content sections, combined with a deep, dark green and off-white palette, creates a unique, almost gothic or antique aesthetic that feels more like an illuminated manuscript than a generic modern portfolio.
